subject.title: fix(discord): preserve content-type and skip optimization for animated/WebP images

question: Should this Discord media fix expose preserveWebp/preserveAvif as public plugin SDK options and fail closed for over-cap preserved media, or should the branch be narrowed to a Discord-owned current-main path before merge?
rationale: The remaining blockers are public API and user-visible delivery contracts; automation should not decide whether third-party plugin callers get new preserve flags or whether oversized preserved media should stop being recompressed.

options.title: Refresh and narrow the contract
options.body: Rebase or replace the branch on current main, keep Discord-specific preservation out of the public SDK unless approved, preserve compatibility where possible, and require live Discord proof before merge.

options.title: Approve the new media contract
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept public preserve options and fail-closed oversized preserved media, but the PR should document and prove that behavior before merge.

options.title: Replace the stale branch
options.body: If the branch is too stale to repair cleanly, keep the linked issue open and replace this PR with a fresh narrow fix that credits the source work.

recommendation.title: Refresh and narrow the contract
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the branch on current main, keep Discord-specific preservation out of the public SDK unless approved, preserve compatibility where possible, and require live Discord proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across the Discord send path, shared media loading, and public SDK boundary involved in this choice.
